# The Threshing Floor

> A gamified spiritual warfare and Bible doctrinal debate experience for gamers, youth, and remnant seekers. Published by Remnant Seed LLC.

The Threshing Floor is an immersive tactical interface that stages doctrinal warfare against historic spiritual adversaries. It features Prophet Gad as a modern-day Elijah figure, a music vault (Prophet Gad Music / Thread Bare Music), and a storefront for ebooks and renditions.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing experience, Threshing Floor entry, doctrinal warfare chat, and storefront.
